label.description: Display name for this Zed debug task.

request.description: Attach to an existing local authenticated multi-dap daemon.

configFile.description: Fully qualified Windows path to the private multi-dap project TOML. Task variables are not supported.

controlDirectory.description: Optional fully qualified Windows path to the same private control directory used by the existing daemon.

perfOutput.description: Optional fully qualified Windows path to a new private host-latency capture file in an existing directory. Existing files are never overwritten.

perfMaxEvents.description: Optional retained-event limit. Requires perfOutput; omission uses the daemon CLI recorder default.
